thread:
Samir: Heads-up — AcmeMed is asking for a two-stage signature flow for the POC orderform. They want the MSA countersigned first, then the PO/invoice after. Also submitted DPA redlines and an SLA bump. Need routing + legal signoff.
Ellie: Do we already have the MSA in DocuSign or are they sending edits?
Samir: MSA is in DocuSign. Envelope id `0a1b2c`. They redlined Appendix B (DPA) to add EU data residency + explicit subprocessors list. They also asked to bump SLA from our standard 99.9% to 99.95% and a 30d credit window.
Jane (Legal): On it. 99.95% is a big ask — need infra signoff and to scope credits. What's expected QPS for the POC?
Mike (ProcOps): Procurement flagged that their policy is PO-first or at least a PO on-file before billing. Finance says they won't release payment without a PO + signed orderform.
Anna (Finance): Confirmed. We typically require an E-signed PO referencing the signed orderform to create the invoice. Net45 preferred by them.
Samir: They explicitly said 'signed MSA first, then we'll issue the PO to finalize billing' — so staged flow. Question: does that break revenue recognition or our billing process?
Jane (Legal): We can accept countersigned MSA first and then a PO that references the orderform. Need to add a short clause in the orderform/addendum that a PO referencing the orderform binds billing. I'll draft.
Ellie: They also left the security questionnaire with KMS set to 'customer-managed / HSM' — wants customer to hold keys. That could be heavy for POC.
Mike (ProcOps): Private deployment + customer KMS is a separate onboarding task. For the POC we can offer a temporary arrangement (transient keys managed by us) with an interim attestation.
Jane (Legal): Need the KMS language updated in the DPA and a one-paragraph interim security appendix for the POC. We can accept a temporary KMS workaround if it's documented and time-limited.
Samir: They want countersign by their counsel within 48h and a DocuSign flow: sequential signers — exec sign MSA -> vendor countersign -> procurement PO after. Can we set that up?
deploy-bot: DocuSign status: envelope `0a1b2c` moved to 'Awaiting Signature' for signer 1 (Acme counsel). https://docusign.example/0a1b2c
Ellie: @Jane — can you get Appendix B/DPA review by EOD? They're pushing to kick the POC early next week. :eyes:
Jane (Legal): Will review now. If we accept EU residency we must pin region + routing policy; Ops needs to confirm.
Mike (ProcOps): Ops can pin the POC to eu-west-1 for data residency. Need SRE confirmation on SLA, and a short ops runbook for the pinned deployment.
Raj (SRE): I can run perf tests and advise. For a low-traffic POC (50–200 QPS) 99.95% is probably achievable on dedicated capacity, but we'd need reserved capacity and active monitoring. For hosted bursts it's riskier.
Jane (Legal): OK — propose two-tier SLA: 99.9% for hosted, 99.95% for dedicated/reserved capacity with explicit credit calculation. Add rollback language if we can't meet SLA within the POC window.
Anna (Finance): For billing: if we accept the post-countersign PO, we'll require the PO to explicitly reference the signed MSA and orderform. We'll invoice on receipt of PO per net45 terms. Wire/ACH preferred. Please confirm bank details before invoicing.
Samir: Also, customer redlined the 'no source access' clause requesting source. We must decline that.
Jane (Legal): Decline source access. Offer SOC2/ISO artifacts and third-party attestation instead. I'll mark the clause as 'Company will provide compliance artifacts; source code access not permitted'.
Ellie: Next steps summary: 1) Jane to return DPA + addendum redline; 2) Mike confirms ops/regional pin + DocuSign staged routing; 3) Anna confirms invoice template and PO wiring process; 4) Raj validates SLA feasibility. Customer wants sign by Tuesday.
Samir: I'll propose a DocuSign template for staged signature: signer 1 = Acme counsel (MSA edits), signer 2 = Redwood legal countersign, signer 3 = Acme procurement PO placeholder. Need DocuSign routing rules so PO field appears only after MSA is countersigned.
deploy-bot: DocuSign tip: use 'sequential signing' and 'placeholder' for subsequent docs. See https://developers.docusign.com/docs/esign-rest-api/reference/envelopes/.
Jane (Legal): Drafting the addendum now. Two asks for Ops/Finance: (a) Ops confirm region pin + SLA support; (b) Finance confirm net terms if PO arrives after countersign.
Anna (Finance): Confirm net45 after countersign is acceptable. I'll prepare the invoice template with a PO reference field and wire instructions to attach.
Samir: Thanks all — I'll update AcmeMed with the staged-signature path and ETA for our redlines. If the envelope moves, I'll post updates here.
Ellie: :thumbsup: Great coordination team.
deploy-bot: DocuSign update: envelope `0a1b2c` signed by Acme counsel at 2358012355 and moved to 'Completed' for signer 1. Remaining signers pending.
